data.name: Nuki
data.detailed_description:
A top-down horror adventure set in a kingdom consumed by shadows and despair. You play as a lone wanderer drawn to this cursed land by whispers of a forgotten truth. Beneath the mist-choked forests lie ancient laboratories, cryptic altars, and forbidden experiments all tied to a mysterious figure whose twisted desires have poisoned the realm. As you explore, the story unfolds through environmental clues, journals, and haunting encounters revealing a tragic legacy that reshapes your understanding of the world

This is not a game of combat but of discovery. The dynamic top-down camera offers fluid control and cinematic tension. Environmental puzzles are woven into the world’s architecture and lore, challenging you to observe and interpret. Progression is linear with hidden paths and underground chambers waiting to be unlocked through careful exploration

You evolve through insight rather than stats. Each puzzle solved and secret uncovered brings you closer to understanding the figure’s influence and your role in the kingdom’s fate

Your goals are to unravel the mystery behind the experiments, navigate treacherous terrain, and solve layered puzzles that reveal the kingdom’s tragic history. Survival depends on your ability to think critically and interpret the world around you

The soundtrack is an epic and haunting orchestral score that evolves with your journey. From sweeping melodies to unsettling ambient tones, the music heightens every moment of isolation and discovery. Sound design plays a vital role in guiding exploration and amplifying tension

The game difficulty allows players to focus on lore and atmosphere without puzzle pressure

This offers a horror experience built on atmosphere, mystery, and emotional storytelling. Its rich environmental symbolism and layered narrative design create a world alive with secrets where every shadow hides meaning. There is no hand-holding—players must think, observe, and interpret to survive

data.short_description: A dark action adventure with old-school aesthetics and a stylized, terrifying atmosphere. Explore a nightmarish forest, solve environmental puzzles, and uncover a story that gradually unfolds, step by step, in the silence. Will they remember your name? Or will you become just another lost soul?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 1600 / Intel Core i5-6600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 (3 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600／Intel Core i7-8700
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 (8 GB)
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains mature content that may not be suitable for all audiences. It features intense and graphic depictions of violence, including combat scenarios with blood, dismemberment, and realistic injury effects. Players may encounter disturbing scenes, dark thematic elements, and morally complex situations. The game also includes strong language and may portray psychological horror or emotionally intense moments. Viewer discretion is advised.
